protocol_fee.applies_to: every transaction, accrued at settlement on the transaction's own network
protocol_fee.capture: accrued + attributed on each receipt; on-chain capture of accrued fees needs a fee-leg authorization / splitter contract (x402 settles a single payTo), so fees are recorded but not auto-moved — status stays "accrued" until a real fee tx exists

flow: POST /api/v1/pay/x402 {target_agent, capability} with no X-PAYMENT -> 402 {x402Version, accepts:[requirements]}
construct payment for accepts[0], base64-encode, resend with header X-PAYMENT: <b64>
x402.note: Set X402_FACILITATOR_URL for real settlement; otherwise receipts are structurally verified.

flow: POST /api/v1/pay/ap2/mandate {type:intent, principal, agent, constraints} to authorize an agent
POST a {type:cart, ...} mandate for a concrete purchase, then settle via x402 as the payment method
ap2.note: AP2 authorizes; x402 settles. Set AP2_VERIFY_KEY for signature verification.
